title: United Stables launches U on Ethereum and BNB Chain
description: United Stables announced the public launch of its U stablecoin on Ethereum and BNB Chain with approved-user mint and redemption routes.
notes: Launch date follows the dated announcement; exact contract deployment transactions remain unresolved.

title: Anchorage Digital Bank and OSL launch USDGO on Solana
description: OSL announced the launch of USDGO, issued by Anchorage Digital Bank, with an initial Solana issuance and enterprise distribution model.
notes: Issuer and distributor roles are separate; exact first mint transaction remains unresolved.

title: SoFi launches SoFiUSD financial infrastructure
description: SoFi announced the launch of SoFiUSD as a fully reserved payment stablecoin and financial-infrastructure product issued by SoFi Bank.
notes: The infrastructure launch is separated from later consumer-app availability.

title: SoFiUSD becomes available through the SoFi banking platform
description: SoFi expanded SoFiUSD from infrastructure use into consumer-facing platform access and supported blockchain availability.
notes: This is a distribution and access expansion, not a second asset launch.

title: Solstice launches USX on Solana
description: Solstice announced the public launch of its Solana-native USX stablecoin and associated yield infrastructure.
notes: Base USX is separated from eUSX and YieldVault positions; canonical mint details remain unresolved.

title: Origin Protocol launches Origin Dollar
description: Origin introduced OUSD as a yield-bearing stablecoin that accrues strategy income directly through rebasing while remaining spendable in user wallets.
notes: The launch is separate from later wrapped representations and strategy changes.

title: Origin Dollar suffers a contract exploit
description: Origin Dollar suffered a November 2020 exploit that disrupted the original system and led to a compensation and recovery process.
notes: The exact restart, compensation completion, and residual claimant chronology remain known unknowns; current OUSD is not classified as failed.
